text: **dsh-session-hub**（DSH Web 插件）：把多台远端 DSH 和本机 AI 工具的历史会话汇入官方会话树。服务端合并远端会话 API，浏览器端接入官方会话运行时，并提供插件设置页管理连接。可查看和控制远端会话、使用 SSH 隧道、导入 Codex/Claude Code/opencode/Pi 历史，以及同步模型配置。适合希望在一个页面整理多台服务器或多种工具对话的用户。远端需配置服务器；SSH 可选，无必需 API Key。

**dsh-session-hub** combines remote DSH sessions and local AI chat histories in the official session tree. It supports remote session control, optional SSH tunnels, imports from Codex, Claude Code, opencode, and Pi, plus model setting sync. Configure remote servers as needed; no API key is required.

**dsh-session-hub** 的功能「远端会话聚合」：将多个服务器的会话与工作区并入本机 DSH 的官方树，并通过原生界面查看、发送消息和管理会话。连接由插件设置页配置。
**dsh-session-hub** 的功能「SSH 隧道连接」：为远端 DSH Web 建立并维护 SSH 本地转发，连接信息在设置页填写，插件以隧道访问远端服务。
**dsh-session-hub** 的功能「本机历史导入」：用户可在设置中逐项选择 Codex、Claude Code、opencode 或 Pi，扫描会话记录并将历史展示为 DSH 会话。
**dsh-session-hub** 的功能「模型配置同步」：将本机已有而远端缺少的模型提供方、默认模型和凭据引用补充到已连接服务器，保留远端已有配置。

dsh-session-hub README · 这是什么：DSH 的会话树只认这一台机器、这一个工具产生的会话。于是：

服务器上跑了一半的任务，要开新标签页、连隧道、从头找起。关掉笔记本再回来，不知道它现在到哪一步。
上周用 Codex CLI 聊过的方案，在 DSH 里根本不存在，只能去翻 `~/.codex` 底下的 JSONL。

这个插件把这两类会话都接进同一棵树：

<!-- 截图占位：侧边栏（服务器分组 + 会话）。补图后替换本行 -->

```text
工作区
├── my-project        ← 本机工作区（官方原样）
├── another-repo      ← 本机工作区
├── tencent           ← 远端服务器，点开就是那台机器的会话

点开任意一个会话，包括远端的，官方对话区照常渲染：历史、逐 token 流式输出、审批卡片、提问问卷，
全是官方组件。插件只搬数据，不画界面。

远端会话并不是你本机在代跑。agent 循环在那台机器自己的 `dsh` 里，本机只是个看板。
所以可以关掉本机去吃饭，回来再接上看它跑到哪了：还在跑就从当前这一刻续上实时流，跑完了就看完整历史。
dsh-session-hub README · 两件独立的事：插件做两件事，互相不依赖，装了可以只开一件（见[配置](#配置)）：

dsh-session-hub README · 🖧 把远端机器接进来：每台服务器成为工作区树里的一个分组（标题带 🖥️ 标识，一眼可辨是远程），组内是那台机器的会话。

- 树内操作是原生语义：**+ 新建会话**在那台机器上创建、**归档 / 删除**路由到会话所在机器、**重命名分组**即重命名服务器、**删除分组**即断开该连接。
- 会话跑在远端，不依赖你开着：agent 循环在那台机器自己的 `dsh` 里推进。本机关掉、断网、换台电脑，远端该跑的照跑。回来时它可能已经跑完了。
- 中途接得上：hub 启动时若远端正在生成，从当前这一刻续上实时流，缺席期间的历史由 `session.history` 补齐，和官方断线重连是同一套语义。
- 对话区零替换：远端会话的历史、实时流、审批与提问卡片全部由官方组件渲染。没有自绘聊天窗，没有 shadow slot。
- 隧道不用你建：填 `user@host` 与私钥路径，插件自己开 SSH 隧道、自己保活重连，本地端口它自己分配。
- 模型配置增量同步：服务器连上后，把本机有而远端缺的提供方、默认模型与 API Key 补过去。只补缺，不覆盖远端已有配置。

dsh-session-hub README · 📥 把其他工具的历史接进来：本机 Codex CLI / Claude Code / opencode 聊过的对话，按项目目录归入对应工作区。

- 按软件逐个手动开启，未点「导入」的软件日志一个字节都不会被读；
- 找不到对应工作区的项目会自动建成真实工作区（只登记，不创建目录）；目录已不存在的会话自动隐藏；
- 导入的会话在树里只读；直接向它发消息会自动转成真实 DSH 会话（保留用户/助手对话，原只读副本隐藏）；
- 源日志只读打开，从不改写、从不删除。

dsh-session-hub README · 两件事共用的底子：- 纯 `/api` 协议：不靠 SSH 执行命令、不做屏幕抓取、不改远端配置，远端不装任何插件，就是一个未经修改的 `dsh web`。
- 官方 UI 零改动：不替换侧边栏、不替换对话区。插件只在数据层做合并与路由。

**只有一台机器？** 第二件事照样成立：不填任何服务器，只开导入，把本机 Codex / Claude Code / opencode 的历史接进来即可。

dsh-session-hub README · 安装：```bash dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-session-hub ``` 装完重启 `dsh web`（`kill -TERM ` 并等待退出，别用 `kill -9`，会在写入中途撕裂会话 zstd 日志），刷新页面。 **设置 → 插件** 里出现 **会话枢纽** 标签页即成功。 `dsh plugin` 把参数原样转发给 profile 目录里的 pnpm（本机需要 pnpm）。不带版本标签装的是正式版 `latest`； 预发布版（如有）需显式 `dsh-session-hub@alpha`。
不走 npm：直接装 GitHub tarball ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/Asaiuta/dsh-session-hub/archive/refs/tags/v0.1.0.tar.gz ``` 仓库已提交构建产物，tarball 安装同样无需本地构建。

dsh-session-hub README · 安装：
从源码安装（改代码调试） ```bash git clone https://github.com/Asaiuta/dsh-session-hub && cd dsh-session-hub npm install && npm run build dsh plugin --profile web add file:$(pwd) ``` 或手动挂载：把 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 insert 条目并入 profile 的 patch 层。
升级 / 禁用 / 彻底移除 **升级**：重跑 add 并重启 `dsh web`： ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-session-hub ```

dsh-session-hub README · 安装：**临时禁用**：从 profile 的 bundle 列表 / `cordis.patch.yml` 移除 `dsh-session-hub` 条目后重启。
服务器注册表保留，重新启用即恢复。

**彻底移除**：移除条目并重启后，删掉这两个文件即可（都在 `$DSH_HOME/plugins/`）：
`dsh-session-hub.json`（服务器注册表）、`dsh-session-hub-imports.json`（导入解析缓存）。
插件从不写入你的项目目录，也不改动任何工具的原始日志。

</details>

dsh-session-hub README · 环境要求：| 项 | 要求 |
|---|---|
| 本机 DSH | 实测 `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.6`；mainline 未逐 commit 跟踪 |
| Node | `^22.19 \|\| >=24`（用到内置 `WebSocket` / `fetch`） |
| Profile | 仅 `web`：插件 inject `webServer` / `apiProxy`，装进 `headless` / `tui` 会一直 pending 并导致该 profile 启动失败 |

| 外部工具 | 仅导入时需要：本机装过 Codex CLI / Claude Code / opencode / Pi 中的任意一个，读它们默认的日志位置 |

远端侧，本机 Windows + Node v24.9.0 对远端 OpenCloudOS 9.4 + Node v24.9.0，经 SSH 隧道跑通跨机对话、审批应答与实时流全链路；

dsh-session-hub README · 快速开始：装完插件后按你要的那件事往下走，两条路互不依赖：

- 只想把本机 Codex / Claude Code / opencode 的历史接进来，直接跳到[导入本机其他工具的会话](#导入本机其他工具的会话)，三次点击就完事，不用配服务器、不用隧道。
- 想接远端机器，从下面这个最小示例开始。

dsh-session-hub README · 接一台远端机器：**最小可复现示例：一台远端 + 本机 hub + SSH 隧道。**

**① 远端**（假设 `10.0.0.5`），什么都不用装，保持默认即可：

```bash
dsh web --port 3080          # 只监听环回，这也是当前唯一允许的绑定
```

**② 本机**，只装插件：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/Asaiuta/dsh-session-hub/archive/refs/tags/v0.1.0.tar.gz

dsh-session-hub README · 重启 dsh web：```

隧道不用自己建，下一步填好 SSH 信息，插件会自己开、自己保活。

**③ 浏览器** `http://127.0.0.1:3080`：

1. **设置 → 插件 → 会话枢纽 → 添加服务器**，保持默认的 **SSH 隧道** 方式，填：

| 字段 | 例 |
   |---|---|
   | 名称 | `tencent` |
   | 主机 | `10.0.0.5` |
   | SSH 用户 | `root` |
   | 私钥路径 | `~/.ssh/id_ed25519`（留空则用 ssh agent） |
   | 远端 dsh 端口 | `3080` |

点**测试**（返回远端 DSH 版本即通）→ **添加**。本地端口由插件自行分配，你不必知道它是多少。
2. 官方工作区树里出现名为 `tencent` 的分组，远端会话就在组内；
3. 点开任一会话，官方对话区照常工作：历史、实时流、审批卡片、发送 / 取消 / 重命名。

dsh-session-hub README · 重启 dsh web：> 已经手动开着 `ssh -L` 的话，切到**直连地址**填 `http://127.0.0.1:<你的端口>` 也可以，插件不会去碰那条隧道。

<!-- 截图占位：设置 → 插件 → 会话枢纽。补图后替换本行 -->

> **为什么一定要隧道**：当前 dsh（0.1.0-rc.6）拒绝把 Web 服务绑到环回以外。`--host 0.0.0.0` 被 CLI 挡下
> （*"would expose remote code execution to the network"*），具体 LAN IP 连配置校验都过不了（`host` 只接受
> `127.0.0.1` 与 `0.0.0.0` 两个字面量）。所以远端保持默认，由隧道把它带到本机环回；这也意味着不存在把 3080
> 暴露公网的选项，上游已经先一步堵死了。
>
> 隧道进程活在 dsh 里：dsh 退出时一并关闭，启动时按保存的配置自动重建（端口每次重新分配，所以配置存的是 SSH
> 目标而不是 URL）。SSH 掉线会以退避重连，恢复后链接自动指向新端口。

dsh-session-hub README · 导入本机其他工具的会话：不需要任何服务器或隧道。打开 **设置 → 插件 → 会话枢纽 → 外部会话**，按软件点「导入」：

| 软件 | 读取位置 |
|---|---|
| Codex CLI | `~/.codex/sessions/**/rollout-*.jsonl` |
| Claude Code | `~/.claude/projects/**/*.jsonl` |
| opencode | `~/.local/share/opencode/opencode.db` |
| Pi Coding Agent | `~/.pi/agent/sessions/**/*.jsonl` |

text:
dsh-session-hub README · 导入本机其他工具的会话：- 未点「导入」的软件，日志一个字节都不会被读；
- 勾选**自动**：60 秒周期扫描 + 导入时增量解析跟进新写入的日志，不勾选就只在你点刷新时更新；
- 导入的会话在树里只读，**工具调用（参数、结果、错误标记）以真实工具卡片显示**，文本与卡片按源日志顺序排列，卡片的 call id / 参数 / 输出均取自原始记录，不合成；
- **移除**：把该软件的会话撤出树，不影响其他软件，也不动原始日志；
- 导入的会话在树里只读；直接向它发消息会自动转成真实 DSH 会话（保留用户/助手对话和工具调用，原只读副本隐藏）。

section: 只要多服务器，不碰本机其他工具的日志

text:
dsh-session-hub README · 它访问什么：读你本机的会话日志（需你逐个授权）、和你配置的服务器通信、不碰你的项目文件。 下面每一项都只在对应功能开着时才发生：关掉导入就不读任何日志，关掉聚合就不发起任何出站连接。
完整清单（文件 / 网络 / 凭据 / 会话内容）

dsh-session-hub README · 它访问什么：**文件访问**：
- 读/写 `$DSH_HOME/plugins/dsh-session-hub.json`（`0600`，原子写：tmp + rename）；
- 读/写 `$DSH_HOME/plugins/dsh-session-hub-imports.json`（导入会话解析缓存，`0600`）；
- 只读扫描本机会话日志：`~/.codex/sessions/**/rollout-*.jsonl`、`~/.claude/projects/**/*.jsonl`、`~/.local/share/opencode/opencode.db`（SQLite 只读打开）、`~/.pi/agent/sessions/**/*.jsonl`，用于生成**只读**的导入会话视图；绝不写回这些文件。**按软件逐个手动导入**：未在设置里点「导入」的软件，其日志不会被读取。

dsh-session-hub README · 它访问什么：**网络**：
- 出站（对每个已配置服务器 `baseUrl`）：HTTP `POST /api/*`（unary RPC）+ WebSocket 升级 `/api/events.mux`、`/api/events.host`；
- 入站（本机进程内）：`/hub/events` SSE（仅环回 Host + 随机 token + 浏览器 same-origin 三重校验）、Typert `/api/sessionHub/*`（环回）；
- 入站（浏览器）：被拦截的 `/api/session.*` 与 `/api/respond` 会经网关再校验环回/`trustedHosts`。

**SSH 密钥**：SSH 隧道条目会按你填写的路径读取私钥（仅用于建立那条隧道），密钥内容不落盘、不外传、不写进插件配置，配置里只存路径。留空则走 ssh agent，插件完全不接触密钥材料。

dsh-session-hub README · 它访问什么：**凭据**：模型同步功能会读取本机 `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml` 明文（仅用于提取 `llm-*` 命名空间 `apiKeyEnv` 引用的密钥值），并在**远端未配置**该引用时经 `credentials.set` 写入远端（唯一的密钥出站方向，隧道/HTTPS 下加密）。密钥从不随响应回传，hub 也不落盘密钥副本。若不想自动推送密钥，可在服务器配置中不启用模型同步（或拆掉该服务器的 `llm-*` 命名空间）。

**用户数据**：远端会话列表、历史内容、实时流会经由 hub 进程与浏览器中转显示。跨机传输走 SSH 隧道（加密，也是目前唯一的连接方式）；我方不明文落盘任何会话内容。

</details>

dsh-session-hub README · 和其他插件共存：生态里已经有 1800+ 个 dsh 插件，其中不少也改前端。这个插件改的是数据层，不是画面层：

| 层 | 谁在改 | 冲突吗 |
|---|---|---|
| 会话/工作区**数据** | 本插件（网关合并 `session.list` / `workspace.list`） | 与 UI 插件不冲突 |
| 侧边栏/对话区**画面** | 各类 UI 插件（换树、换主题、加 Tab） | 本插件一个都不占 |

本插件在浏览器侧只做一件事：往 `settings.plugins.tab` 这个 **list 槽**加一个 `id: 'session-hub'` 的条目。
不 shadow `sidebar.workspaces`，不 shadow `conversation`，不碰任何单槽，所以换侧边栏、换对话区、换主题的插件都能与它并存。

dsh-session-hub README · 和其他插件共存：换树的插件反而会自动显示远端与导入的会话：它们通过官方 `useSessions` / `useWorkspaces` 取数， 而这两个 hook 的上游正是本插件合并过的 `/api`。例如 `dsh-plugin-ya-workspace-sidebar` 完整替换了 `sidebar.workspaces`，本插件的服务器分组和导入会话照样出现在它画的树里，双方互不知情。
唯一的冲突：也拦截 /api 的插件 DSH 的 web server 对同一条 exact 路径只允许一个注册者（重复注册直接抛错，这是刻意的组合约定）。 本插件为实现会话合并，接管了这些路径：

dsh-session-hub README · 和其他插件共存：```
/api/session.list      /api/session.history   /api/session.prompt    /api/session.cancel
/api/session.rename    /api/session.fork      /api/session.models    /api/session.selectModel
/api/session.updateQueue  /api/session.attachment  /api/session.search  /api/session.create
/api/workspace.list    /api/workspace.rename  /api/workspace.delete  /api/workspace.archiveSession

另一个插件若也拦截其中任意一条，本插件会让出已占的路由并降级，`dsh` 与对方插件照常运行：

dsh-session-hub README · 和其他插件共存：```
[dsh-session-hub] gateway DISABLED — webserver: duplicate exact route "/api/respond".
Another plugin intercepts the same route, so remote servers and imported sessions will not appear.
Set features.aggregate and features.importer to false to silence this, or remove the conflicting plugin.
```

此时远端会话与导入会话不会出现（这两项功能依赖那些路由），但 DSH 本身、对方插件、以及本插件的设置页都正常。
把 `features.aggregate` 与 `features.importer` 设为 `false` 可消除这条告警。

dsh-session-hub README · 和其他插件共存：> 这条路径实机验证过：用一个抢占 `/api/respond` 的测试插件复现，`dsh` 首页仍 `200`、官方 `session.list` 正常应答、
> `sessionHub` 端点存活，路由撞车不会拖垮宿主。

绝大多数插件不走这条路：加工具、加技能、加 UI、加 Tab 都不需要拦截 `/api`。

</details>

**Typert 命名空间**：本插件独占 `sessionHub`（对应 `/api/sessionHub/*`），SSE 独占 `/hub/events`。命名空间撞车的可能性极低。

dsh-session-hub README · 和 `dsh-remote` 的分界：[`dsh-remote`](https://github.com/flymysql/dsh-remote) 同样做“远程”，但做的是另一件事。两者技术上不冲突（它占 `/dsh-remote/*` 与工作区选择器槽，我们占 `/api/*` 与设置页 Tab，实机同装验证过），可以一起装。

区别在于 agent 循环在谁家跑：

| | `dsh-remote` | `dsh-session-hub` |
|---|---|---|
| 远端需要什么 | 只要 `sshd` | 一个跑着的 `dsh web` |
| 谁在干活 | 本机的 agent，通过 SSH 伸手过去 | 远端自己的 agent |
| 会话存在哪 | 都在本机 | 各机器自己的 `~/.dsh` |
| 本机关机后 | 任务停了 | 远端继续跑 |
| 别人在远端发起的会话 | 看不到（远端没有会话） | 树里直接出现 |

选型规则：

> 远端能装 dsh → 本插件（远端自己有会话，你去聚合）
> 远端只有 sshd → `dsh-remote`（本机伸手过去操作）
dsh-session-hub README · 和 `dsh-remote` 的分界：客户的生产机、不允许装东西的跳板机，适合用 `dsh-remote`。而想要“关机之后任务继续跑”，则必须让远端自己有一个 `dsh`。

dsh-session-hub README · 常见问题：| 症状 | 原因 / 处理 |
|---|---|
| 添加服务器报 `self-loop` | baseUrl 指向 hub 自身。插件启动时也会自动检测并跳过自环条目（日志 warn） |
| 历史加载失败 `signal timed out` | 最常见：SSH 隧道断了。检查 `netstat -ano \| grep :3333`；重启隧道后远端自动重连 |
| 历史加载失败 `invalid_value … expected "server-response"` | 旧版本网关直通缺陷，升级到 0.1.0-alpha.1+（已修复：出口统一补 `type: 'server-response'`） |
| 会话列表少了一项 | 冷启动后远端首个 `session.list` 拉取未完成；打开会话本身会触发重拉 |
| 实时流断开（LIVE 徽标变灰） | SSE 自动重连；发送后 900ms 无实时事件自动回退历史重载 |
| 本机关了一阵子，远端会话现在怎么看 | 直接点开就行。远端还在跑就从当前这一刻续上实时流，缺席那段由历史补齐；已跑完则直接看到完整结果 |
| 远端明明停了，UI 还在转圈 | 0.1.0-alpha.2 之前的缺陷：`host/session-status` 帧送错了入口被丢弃。升级即可；临时解法是刷新页面 |
| 插件未生效 | 检查 `dsh plugin` 后是否重启 web；看启动日志有无 `dsh-session-hub` 加载与 gateway 使能信息 |
| 点了「导入」但树里没有 | 该软件的会话所属项目目录已不存在，目录不在磁盘上的会话会被自动隐藏；恢复目录后一个扫描周期内回来 |
| 导入的会话发不出消息 | 正常：导入会话只读。直接发送会自动转成真实 DSH 会话，之后照常对话 |
| 某个软件显示「未安装」 | 只按默认路径查找（`~/.codex` / `~/.claude` / `~/.local/share/opencode` / `~/.pi`）；装在别处目前无法指定 |
| 移除某个软件后别的也少了 | 0.1.0-alpha.1 之前的缺陷（跨源误删），升级即可 |

dsh-session-hub README · What this is：DSH's session tree only knows sessions created on this machine by this tool. So:

A job half-finished on a server needs a new tab, a tunnel, and a hunt through logs. Close the laptop and come
back — no idea where it is now. A plan you discussed with Codex CLI last week does not exist in DSH at all;
you go dig through the JSONL files under `~/.codex`.

This plugin brings both kinds of sessions into the same tree:

dsh-session-hub README · What this is：```text
Workspaces
├── my-project        ← local workspace (official, untouched)
├── another-repo      ← local workspace
├── 🖥️ tencent        ← remote server group; open it to see that machine's sessions

Open any session — remote included — and the official conversation pane renders it as usual: history,
token-by-token streaming, approval cards, question forms. All official components. The plugin only moves data;
it draws no UI.

dsh-session-hub README · What this is：Remote sessions are not proxied locally. The agent loop runs inside that machine's own `dsh`; your machine is
just a dashboard. Close the laptop and grab lunch; when you come back, if the session is still running the live
stream picks up from the current moment, and if it already finished you see the complete result.

dsh-session-hub README · Two independent features：The plugin does two things. They do not depend on each other — **you can enable only one**
(see [Configuration](#configuration)):

dsh-session-hub README · 🖧 Bringing remote machines in：Each server becomes a group in the workspace tree (the title carries a 🖥️ marker so its remote origin is
obvious at a glance), containing that machine's sessions.

dsh-session-hub README · 🖧 Bringing remote machines in：- Tree operations are native semantics: **+ New session** creates it on that machine, **Archive / Delete**

- Sessions run remotely, not on your machine: the agent loop advances inside that machine's own `dsh`.
  Turning off your machine, losing network, or switching computers does not stop it. When you come back it
  may already be done.
- Joining mid-run: if the remote is generating when the hub starts, the live stream resumes from the current

- Zero replacement in the conversation pane: history, live stream, approval and question cards for remote
  sessions are all rendered by official components. No self-drawn chat window, no shadow slots.
- No tunnel setup on your side: fill in `user@host` and a private key path, and the plugin opens the SSH
  tunnel itself, keeps it alive and reconnects it, allocating the local port on its own.
- Incremental model config sync: when a server connects, providers, defaul
dsh-session-hub README · 📥 Bringing other tools' history in：Conversations from local Codex CLI / Claude Code / opencode / Pi land in their project workspace by directory.

dsh-session-hub README · 📥 Bringing other tools' history in：- Enabled per tool, manually. Tools you have not clicked **Import** for are never read — not a byte.
- Projects with no matching workspace are auto-registered as real workspaces (registration only, no
  directories are created); sessions whose project directory no longer exists are hidden automatically.
- Imported sessions are read-only in the tree; sending a message to one automatically promotes it to a real

  routes at the data layer only.

**One machine only?** The second feature still applies: add no servers, enable just the importer, and pull in
your local Codex / Claude Code / opencode / Pi history.

dsh-session-hub README · restart dsh web：> If you already run `ssh -L` by hand, switch to **Direct address** and fill in
> `http://127.0.0.1:<your port>`; the plugin will not touch that tunnel.

dsh-session-hub README · restart dsh web：> **Why a tunnel is mandatory**: current dsh (0.1.0-rc.6) refuses to bind the web server beyond loopback.
> `--host 0.0.0.0` is blocked by the CLI (*"would expose remote code execution to the network"*), and a
> concrete LAN IP fails config validation (`host` accepts only the two literals `127.0.0.1` and `0.0.0.0`).
> So the remote stays on defaults and the tunnel brings it to the local loopback — which also means there is
> no option to expose :3080 publicly; upstream has already closed that door.
>
> The tunnel process lives inside dsh: it closes when dsh exits, and rebuilds on startup from the saved
> config (the port is reallocated each time, so the config stores the SSH target, not a URL). On SSH drop it
> reconnects with backoff, and the link follows the new port.

dsh-session-hub README · What it accesses：It reads your local session logs (per tool, as you authorize), talks to the servers you configure, and never touches your project files. Every item below happens only while its feature is enabled: with the importer off no logs are read; with aggregation off no outbound connections are made.
Full list (files / network / credentials / session content)

dsh-session-hub README · What it accesses：**File access**:
- Reads/writes `$DSH_HOME/plugins/dsh-session-hub.json` (`0600`, atomic: tmp + rename);
- Reads/writes `$DSH_HOME/plugins/dsh-session-hub-imports.json` (imported-session parse cache, `0600`);
- Read-only scans of local session logs: `~/.codex/sessions/**/rollout-*.jsonl`,
  `~/.claude/projects/**/*.jsonl`, `~/.local/share/opencode/opencode.db` (SQLite opened read-only),
  `~/.pi/agent/sessions/**/*.jsonl`, to build **read-only** imported session views; never written back.
  **Enabled per tool, manually**: a tool you have not clicked **Import** for is never read.

dsh-session-hub README · What it accesses：**Network**:
- Outbound (per configured server `baseUrl`): HTTP `POST /api/*` (unary RPC) + WebSocket upgrade
  `/api/events.mux`, `/api/events.host`;
- Inbound (local, in-process): `/hub/events` SSE (loopback host + random token + browser same-origin, a
  three-way fence), Typert `/api/sessionHub/*` (loopback);
- Inbound (browser): intercepted `/api/session.*` and `/api/respond` are re-checked by the gateway against
  loopback / `trustedHosts`.

dsh-session-hub README · What it accesses：**Credentials**: model sync reads the local `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml` plaintext (only to resolve secret
values referenced via `apiKeyEnv` in the `llm-*` namespaces) and writes them via `credentials.set` to the
remote **only when that reference is not yet configured there** (the only outbound direction for secrets;
encrypted under tunnel/HTTPS). Secrets never ride response traffic back, and the hub keeps no copy of them.
To avoid any automatic secret push, turn off model sync for the server (or drop its `llm-*` namespaces).

dsh-session-hub README · What it accesses：**User data**: remote session lists, history content and live streams transit the hub process to the browser.
Cross-machine transport runs over the SSH tunnel (encrypted — currently the only connection mode); the
plugin never writes session content to disk in cleartext.

</details>

dsh-session-hub README · Coexistence with other plugins：The ecosystem already has 1800+ dsh plugins and many touch the frontend. This one changes the data layer,
not the presentation layer:

| Layer | Who changes it | Conflict? |
|---|---|---|
| Session/workspace **data** | this plugin (gateway merging `session.list` / `workspace.list`) | no conflict with UI plugins |
| Sidebar/conversation **presentation** | assorted UI plugins (trees, themes, tabs) | this plugin occupies none |

dsh-session-hub README · Coexistence with other plugins：On the browser side the plugin does exactly one thing: adds a `id: 'session-hub'` entry to the
`settings.plugins.tab` **list slot**. It shadows no `sidebar.workspaces`, no `conversation`, no single slot —
so sidebar, conversation and theme plugins all coexist with it.

dsh-session-hub README · Coexistence with other plugins：Tree-replacing plugins actually show remote and imported sessions for free: they read through the official
`useSessions` / `useWorkspaces` hooks, whose upstream is precisely this plugin's merged `/api`. For example,
`dsh-plugin-ya-workspace-sidebar` fully replaces `sidebar.workspaces`, and this plugin's server groups and
imported sessions still appear in the tree it draws — neither knows about the other.

dsh-session-hub README · Coexistence with other plugins：
The one conflict: plugins that also intercept /api DSH's web server allows exactly one registrant per exact route (duplicate registration throws on purpose — a deliberate composition rule). To merge sessions this plugin takes over these routes:

dsh-session-hub README · Coexistence with other plugins：```
/api/session.list      /api/session.history   /api/session.prompt    /api/session.cancel
/api/session.rename    /api/session.fork      /api/session.models    /api/session.selectModel
/api/session.updateQueue  /api/session.attachment  /api/session.search  /api/session.create
/api/workspace.list    /api/workspace.rename  /api/workspace.delete  /api/workspace.archiveSession

dsh-session-hub README · Coexistence with other plugins：If another plugin intercepts any of them, this plugin yields the occupied routes and degrades; `dsh` and the
other plugin keep working:

```
[dsh-session-hub] gateway DISABLED — webserver: duplicate exact route "/api/respond".
Another plugin intercepts the same route, so remote servers and imported sessions will not appear.
Set features.aggregate and features.importer to false to silence this, or remove the conflicting plugin.
```

dsh-session-hub README · Coexistence with other plugins：Remote sessions and imported sessions then do not appear (both features depend on those routes), but DSH
itself, the other plugin, and this plugin's settings page all stay healthy. Set `features.aggregate` and
`features.importer` to `false` to silence the warning.

dsh-session-hub README · Coexistence with other plugins：> This path was exercised on a real machine: with a test plugin hogging `/api/respond`, the `dsh` homepage
> still returned `200`, the official `session.list` answered normally, the `sessionHub` endpoint stayed
> alive — a route collision cannot take the host down.

The vast majority of plugins never go this route: tools, skills, UI, tabs do not need `/api` interception.

dsh-session-hub README · Coexistence with other plugins：**Typert namespace**: this plugin owns `sessionHub` (= `/api/sessionHub/*`) exclusively; SSE owns
`/hub/events`. A namespace collision is extremely unlikely.

dsh-session-hub README · Boundary with `dsh-remote`：[`dsh-remote`](https://github.com/flymysql/dsh-remote) also does "remote", but a different thing. The two are
technically non-conflicting (it occupies `/dsh-remote/*` and the workspace selector slot; we occupy `/api/*`
and a settings tab — verified side-by-side on a real machine), and can be installed together.

The difference is whose machine runs the agent loop:

dsh-session-hub README · Boundary with `dsh-remote`：| | `dsh-remote` | `dsh-session-hub` |
|---|---|---|
| What the remote needs | just `sshd` | a running `dsh web` |
| Who does the work | your agent, reaching over SSH | the remote's own agent |
| Where sessions live | all on your machine | in each machine's own `~/.dsh` |
| Your machine off | work stops | the remote keeps going |
| Sessions started by others remotely | not visible (the remote has no sessions) | appear directly in the tree |

Decision rule:

dsh-session-hub README · Boundary with `dsh-remote`：> Remote can run dsh → this plugin (the remote owns its sessions; you aggregate them)
> Remote has only sshd → `dsh-remote` (reach over from your machine)

For production boxes you cannot install on, or jump hosts, `dsh-remote` fits. To have work continue after you
shut down, the remote must run its own `dsh`.

dsh-session-hub README · FAQ：| Symptom | Cause / fix |
|---|---|
| Add server fails with `self-loop` | baseUrl points at the hub itself. The plugin also auto-detects and skips self-loop entries at startup (log warn) |
| History load fails `signal timed out` | most common: the SSH tunnel dropped. Check `netstat -ano \| grep :3333`; the remote reconnects after the tunnel restarts |
| History load fails `invalid_value … expected "server-response"` | a gateway passthrough bug in old versions; upgrade to 0.1.0-alpha.1+ (fixed: the exit uniformly stamps `type: 'server-response'`) |
| A session is missing from the list | on cold start the remote's first `session.list` pull may not have finished; opening the session itself triggers a re-pull |
| Live stream dropped (LIVE badge went grey) | SSE auto-reconnects; if no live event arrives within 900ms after sending, it falls back to a history reload |
| How do I see a remote session after my machine was off for a while | just open it. Still running: the live stream resumes from the current moment, the gap is backfilled from history. Already done: you see the full result |
| Remote clearly stopped, UI still spins | defect before 0.1.0-alpha.2:

dsh-session-hub README · FAQ：**Logs**: `dsh web` process stdout/stderr (systemd: `journalctl -u dsh-web`; nohup: the output file;
local terminal: the console).

**Rollback**: `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-session-hub@<previous version>` and restart. The registry
file is backwards compatible (unknown fields are ignored); downgrading loses no config. Breaking changes and
downgrade notes per version are in [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md).

dsh-session-hub README · Development：- Type checking runs against the repo's own `stubs/` (a minimal declaration surface transcribed from the
  harness sources, mapped via tsconfig `paths`); building against a real DSH checkout means dropping
  `paths`/`stubs` and pointing `@deepseek-ai/*` back to `link:` devDeps (see dsh-interconnect).
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` are not published to npm; the runtime profile provides them, which is why every
  peerDep is optional.
- Tests: no automated suite yet; the smoke paths (gateway merge dedupe, SSE three-way auth, real-time
  cross-machine dialogue, approval answering, self-loop rejection) are verified manually on real machines.
  Test and PR contributions welcome.

dsh-session-hub README · Architecture：```
┌──────────────────────── local DSH process ────────────────────────┐
│  host plugin (src/index.ts → hub/)                                 │
│                                                                    │
│  ServerRegistry ──persists── $DSH_HOME/plugins/dsh-session-hub.json │

dsh-session-hub README · Architecture：**Live channel**: every remote link's mux/host WS frames fan out through `HubEventBus` to the local SSE
`/hub/events`; the browser dedupes by `event.seq` against the history baseline (opening a session pulls the
tail history first; live events buffer and apply when `seq > tailSeq`), `assistant/chunk` deltas fold into
per-token bubbles, approval/question frames surface as cards on arrival; SSE auto-reconnects on drop.
